blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Over 140,000 visitors flocked to the Manila Memorial Park in Parañaque City on Monday, All Souls’ Day, according to the memorial park administration. The figure was based on the cemetery’s visitor count as of 3 p.m. on Nov. 2, with 13,658 more heading into the cemetery, bringing their total crowd estimate for the day to 141,069. To help cope with the heat, some visitors brought in and set up their own tents near the gravesites of their loved ones.
